desc:
Poodle -> Elephant -> Turtle! Keep the chain alive in this fast-paced word game!

Each round, say a word that starts with the last letter of the word before it. The longer the game goes, the harder it gets.

💬 One word at a time
🔁 No repeating words
⚡ Think fast or get knocked out
🐶 Use pets to gain special abilities
🧠 May the sharpest brain win

👍 Like the game and join the group for future updates!

--[[

    ║                     EXODEVTH MASTER HUB                       ║
    ║             FINISH THE WORD! [ FULL SYSTEM v3.0 ]             ║
    ║                                                               ║
    ║  Author: ExodevTH                                            ║
    ║  Architecture: Glass Deck UI (580x420 Frameless Engine)       ║
    ║  Target Game: Finish The Word! (PlaceId: 91704854174760)      ║
    ╚═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╝
]]

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local HttpService = game:GetService("HttpService")
local VirtualUser = game:GetService("VirtualUser")

local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer
local PlayerGui = LocalPlayer:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

-- Clean up any previous instance of ExodevTH Hub
local gethui = gethui or function() return nil end
local targetParent = gethui() or game:GetService("CoreGui") or PlayerGui
if targetParent:FindFirstChild("ExodevTH_FinishTheWord") then
    targetParent.ExodevTH_FinishTheWord:Destroy()
end
if PlayerGui:FindFirstChild("ExodevTH_FinishTheWord") then
    PlayerGui.ExodevTH_FinishTheWord:Destroy()
end
if _G.ExodevTH_Cleanup then
    pcall(_G.ExodevTH_Cleanup)
end

_G.ExodevTH_Conns = {}
local function trackConn(c)
    if c then table.insert(_G.ExodevTH_Conns, c) end
    return c
end

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- GAME SERVICES & REMOTES
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
local EventService
pcall(function()
    EventService = require(ReplicatedStorage.Services.Communication.event)
end)

local GameKeyStrokeFn = nil
pcall(function()
    local th = require(LocalPlayer.PlayerScripts.Handlers.tableHandler)
    GameKeyStrokeFn = debug.getupvalue(th.Run, 6)
end)

local function typeLetter(char)
    local sent = false
    if GameKeyStrokeFn then
        local ok = pcall(GameKeyStrokeFn, char)
        if ok then sent = true end
    end
    if not sent and EventService then
        EventService.remoteFire("keyStroke", char)
    end
end

local function backspace()
    if EventService then
        EventService.remoteFire("keyStroke", -1)
    end
end

local function trySubmit()
    if EventService then
        EventService.remoteFire("tryAnswer")
    end
end

local function chooseLetter(letter)
    if EventService then
        EventService.remoteFire("chooseLetter", letter)
    end
end

local PREFIX_INDEX = {}
local IS_COMMON_WORD = {}
local TOTAL_WORDS = 0

local function indexWord(word, isCommon)
    TOTAL_WORDS = TOTAL_WORDS + 1
    if isCommon then IS_COMMON_WORD[word] = true end
    local len = #word
    for pLen = 1, math.min(len, 4) do
        local p = word:sub(1, pLen)
        local bucket = PREFIX_INDEX[p]
        if not bucket then
            bucket = {}
            PREFIX_INDEX[p] = bucket
        end
        table.insert(bucket, word)
    end
end

for w in COMMON_WORDS_BLOB:gmatch("[^,]+") do
    indexWord(w, true)
end

for w in FALLBACK_WORDS_BLOB:gmatch("[^,]+") do
    indexWord(w, false)
end

local function isValidEnglishWord(w)
    if not w or #w < 3 or #w > 14 then return false end
    if BlacklistedWords[w] then return false end
    -- Must contain at least one vowel
    if not w:match("[AEIOUY]") then return false end
    -- Reject strings with 4 consecutive non-vowels
    if w:match("[BCDFGHJKLMNPQRSTVWXZ][BCDFGHJKLMNPQRSTVWXZ][BCDFGHJKLMNPQRSTVWXZ][BCDFGHJKLMNPQRSTVWXZ]") then
        return false
    end
    return true
end

local function countMatchWords()
    local n = 0
    for _ in pairs(MatchUsedWords) do n = n + 1 end
    return n
end

local function recordWordUsed(word)
    if not word or #word == 0 then return end
    word = string.upper(word)
    MatchUsedWords[word] = true
    TurnCounter = TurnCounter + 1
    SessionLastUsedTurn[word] = TurnCounter
    table.insert(SessionHistory, word)
    LastSubmittedWord = word
    if #SessionHistory > 100 then
        table.remove(SessionHistory, 1)
    end
end

local function isRecentlyUsedInSession(word, turnsBack)
    local last = SessionLastUsedTurn[word]
    if not last then return false end
    return (TurnCounter - last) < turnsBack
end

local function clearExtraKeys(md, targetLength)
    if not md or not md:FindFirstChild("AnswerInput") or not md.AnswerInput:FindFirstChild("Keys") then return end
    local currentCount = 0
    for i = 1, 25 do
        local k = md.AnswerInput.Keys:FindFirstChild(tostring(i))
        if k and k:IsA("GuiObject") then
            local txt = k:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("TextLabel", true)
            if txt and #txt.Text > 0 and txt.Text ~= " " and txt.Text ~= "_" then
                currentCount = i
            end
        end
    end
    while currentCount > targetLength do
        backspace()
        currentCount = currentCount - 1
        task.wait(0.035)
    end
end

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 4-STRATEGY WORD FINDER ENGINE
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
local function findWordForPrompt(prompt)
    if not prompt or #prompt == 0 then return nil end
    local pUpper = string.upper(prompt):gsub("%s+", "")
    if #pUpper == 0 then return nil end

    -- Fetch candidates from PREFIX_INDEX
    local candidates = PREFIX_INDEX[pUpper]
    if (not candidates or #candidates == 0) and #pUpper > 2 then
        candidates = PREFIX_INDEX[pUpper:sub(1, 2)]
    end
    if not candidates or #candidates == 0 then
        candidates = PREFIX_INDEX[pUpper:sub(1, 1)]
    end

    if not candidates or #candidates == 0 then
        return nil
    end

    -- Filter all valid candidates that strictly start with pUpper and not used in this match
    local pool = {}
    for _, w in ipairs(candidates) do
        if #w > #pUpper and w:sub(1, #pUpper) == pUpper and isValidEnglishWord(w) and not MatchUsedWords[w] and not BlacklistedWords[w] then
            table.insert(pool, w)
        end
    end

    -- Fallback: if pool empty, allow blacklisted/recent, but still strictly not used in current match
    if #pool == 0 then
        for _, w in ipairs(candidates) do
            if #w > #pUpper and w:sub(1, #pUpper) == pUpper and not MatchUsedWords[w] and w ~= LastSubmittedWord then
                table.insert(pool, w)
            end
        end
    end

    if #pool == 0 then
        return nil
    end

    -- STRATEGY 1: Shortest (Speedrun)
    if State.StrategyMode == "Shortest" then
        table.sort(pool, function(a, b)
            if #a ~= #b then return #a < #b end
            local cA = IS_COMMON_WORD[a] and 1 or 0
            local cB = IS_COMMON_WORD[b] and 1 or 0
            return cA > cB
        end)
        return pool[1]
    end

    -- STRATEGY 2: Longest (Flex / Vocabulary)
    if State.StrategyMode == "Longest" then
        table.sort(pool, function(a, b)
            if #a ~= #b then return #a > #b end
            local cA = IS_COMMON_WORD[a] and 1 or 0
            local cB = IS_COMMON_WORD[b] and 1 or 0
            return cA > cB
        end)
        return pool[1]
    end

    -- STRATEGY 3: Random
    if State.StrategyMode == "Random" then
        return pool[math.random(1, #pool)]
    end

    -- STRATEGY 4: Natural Human (Default)
    local common = {}
    for _, w in ipairs(pool) do
        if IS_COMMON_WORD[w] then
            table.insert(common, w)
        end
    end

    local choices = #common > 0 and common or pool
    -- Prefer realistic 4 to 7 letter words
    local normal = {}
    for _, w in ipairs(choices) do
        if #w >= 4 and #w <= 7 then
            table.insert(normal, w)
        end
    end

    if #normal > 0 then
        return normal[math.random(1, #normal)]
    else
        return choices[math.random(1, #choices)]
    end
end

_G.ExodevTH_findWordForPrompt = findWordForPrompt

local function createSlider(parent, labelText, minVal, maxVal, defaultVal, callback)
    local row = Instance.new("Frame")
    row.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 36)
    row.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    row.Parent = parent

    local lbl = Instance.new("TextLabel")
    lbl.Size = UDim2.new(1, -50, 0, 16)
    lbl.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    lbl.Font = Theme.FontNormal
    lbl.Text = labelText
    lbl.TextColor3 = Theme.TextPrimary
    lbl.TextSize = 11
    lbl.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
    lbl.Parent = row

    local valLbl = Instance.new("TextLabel")
    valLbl.Size = UDim2.new(0, 48, 0, 16)
    valLbl.Position = UDim2.new(1, -48, 0, 0)
    valLbl.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    valLbl.Font = Theme.FontBold
    valLbl.Text = tostring(defaultVal)
    valLbl.TextColor3 = Theme.Accent
    valLbl.TextSize = 11
    valLbl.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Right
    valLbl.Parent = row

    local sliderBg = Instance.new("Frame")
    sliderBg.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 8)
    sliderBg.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 20)
    sliderBg.BackgroundColor3 = Theme.WellBg
    sliderBg.BorderSizePixel = 0
    sliderBg.Parent = row

    local sBgCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
    sBgCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
    sBgCorner.Parent = sliderBg

    local fill = Instance.new("Frame")
    local initRatio = math.clamp((defaultVal - minVal) / (maxVal - minVal), 0, 1)
    fill.Size = UDim2.new(initRatio, 0, 1, 0)
    fill.BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Accent
    fill.BorderSizePixel = 0
    fill.Parent = sliderBg

    local fillCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
    fillCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
    fillCorner.Parent = fill

    local sliding = false
    local function updateFromPos(xPos)
        local rel = math.clamp((xPos - sliderBg.AbsolutePosition.X) / sliderBg.AbsoluteSize.X, 0, 1)
        local val = math.floor(minVal + (maxVal - minVal) * rel)
        fill.Size = UDim2.new(rel, 0, 1, 0)
        valLbl.Text = tostring(val)
        if callback then callback(val) end
    end

    sliderBg.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
        if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
            sliding = true
            updateFromPos(input.Position.X)
        end
    end)
    trackConn(UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
        if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
            sliding = false
        end
    end))
    trackConn(UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
        if sliding and (input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch) then
            updateFromPos(input.Position.X)
        end
    end))

    return row
end

local function attemptSitAtTable(tableObj)
    if not tableObj or not tableObj:FindFirstChild("Chairs") then return false end
    local chairs = tableObj.Chairs:GetChildren()
    for _, c in ipairs(chairs) do
        if c:IsA("Seat") and c.Occupant == nil then
            if LocalPlayer.Character and LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then
                LocalPlayer.Character.HumanoidRootPart.CFrame = c.CFrame + Vector3.new(0, 1.5, 0)
                if firetouchinterest then
                    firetouchinterest(LocalPlayer.Character.HumanoidRootPart, c, 0)
                    task.wait(0.04)
                    firetouchinterest(LocalPlayer.Character.HumanoidRootPart, c, 1)
                end
                local hum = LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Humanoid")
                if hum then pcall(function() hum:Sit(c) end) end
                return true
            end
        end
    end
    return false
end

-- GAME MECHANICS & TURN SOLVER ENGINE
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
local function getVisibleChoices()
    local choices = {}
    local sg = PlayerGui:FindFirstChild("ScreenGui")
    if sg and sg:FindFirstChild("ChoiceList") then
        local list = sg.ChoiceList
        for i = 1, 4 do
            local c = list:FindFirstChild(tostring(i))
            if c and c.Visible then
                local label = c:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("TextLabel", true)
                if label and #label.Text > 0 then
                    table.insert(choices, label.Text)
                end
            end
        end
    end
    return choices
end

local function getStartingPrompt(md)
    -- 1. Official Category prompt from MatchDisplay
    if md and md:FindFirstChild("Category") and #md.Category.Text > 0 and md.Category.Text ~= "Choose a letter" then
        return md.Category.Text
    end

    -- 2. Attribute RequiredLetter
    local attr = LocalPlayer:GetAttribute("RequiredLetter")
    if attr and #attr > 0 and attr ~= "Choose a letter" then
        return attr
    end

    -- 3. Concatenate all consecutive locked keys on the board
    if md and md:FindFirstChild("AnswerInput") and md.AnswerInput:FindFirstChild("Keys") then
        local keyStr = ""
        local idx = 1
        while true do
            local k = md.AnswerInput.Keys:FindFirstChild(tostring(idx))
            if not k or not k:IsA("GuiObject") then break end
            local txt = k:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("TextLabel", true)
            if txt and #txt.Text > 0 and txt.Text ~= " " and txt.Text ~= "_" then
                keyStr = keyStr .. txt.Text
                idx = idx + 1
            else
                break
            end
        end
        if #keyStr > 0 then
            return keyStr
        end
    end

    return nil
end

local function solveCurrentTurn()
    if not State.AutoSolve or State.CurrentTurnSolved then return end
    if LocalPlayer:GetAttribute("IsTurn") ~= true then return end

    local sg = PlayerGui:FindFirstChild("ScreenGui")
    if not sg or not sg.Enabled then return end

    local inGameId = LocalPlayer:GetAttribute("InGame")
    if not inGameId or inGameId == "" then return end

    local tableObj = workspace:FindFirstChild("Meta") and workspace.Meta:FindFirstChild("Tables") and workspace.Meta.Tables:FindFirstChild(tostring(inGameId))
    if not tableObj then return end

    local tModel = tableObj:FindFirstChild("Table")
    local bg = tModel and tModel:FindFirstChild("BillboardGui")
    local pc = bg and bg:FindFirstChild("PlayerCount")
    if pc and pc.Visible then return end

    local md = tModel and tModel:FindFirstChild("MatchDisplay")
    if not md then return end

    -- Rate-limit failure protection: avoid log spam loop
    if LastFailureTime > 0 and (os.clock() - LastFailureTime) < 2.0 then
        return
    end

    -- LOCK TURN
    State.CurrentTurnSolved = true

    local ok, err = pcall(function()
        local qLabel = sg:FindFirstChild("QuestionLabel", true)
        local qText = qLabel and qLabel.Text:lower() or ""

        -- MODE A: Multiple Choice Letter Pick (Signals start of a round/match)
        if qText:find("pick") or prompt == "Choose a letter" or prompt == "Pick a letter" then
            if countMatchWords() > 0 then
                resetMatchWords("New Round/Match (Pick Phase)")
            end
            local choices = getVisibleChoices()
            if #choices > 0 then
                local bestChoice = choices[1]
                local bestCount = 0
                for _, ch in ipairs(choices) do
                    local count = PREFIX_INDEX[ch] and #PREFIX_INDEX[ch] or 0
                    if count > bestCount then
                        bestCount = count
                        bestChoice = ch
                    end
                end
                appendLog(string.format("Pick Round: Selected '%s' (%d word paths)", bestChoice, bestCount), Theme.Accent)
                chooseLetter(bestChoice)
                return
            end
        end

        -- MODE B: Word Typing
        local prompt = getStartingPrompt(md)
        if not prompt or prompt == "" or prompt == "Choose a letter" then
            State.CurrentTurnSolved = false
            return
        end

        MatchState.CurrentPrompt = prompt
        PromptVal.Text = prompt

        local targetWord = findWordForPrompt(prompt)
        if not targetWord then
            LastFailurePrompt = prompt
            LastFailureTime = os.clock()
            appendLog(string.format("No dictionary word for '%s' (Waiting 2s)", prompt), Theme.Danger)
            task.delay(2.0, function()
                State.CurrentTurnSolved = false
            end)
            return
        end

        LastFailurePrompt = nil
        LastFailureTime = 0

        MatchState.NextSuggestedWord = targetWord
        WordVal.Text = targetWord
        recordWordUsed(targetWord)
        State.SessionWordsSolved = State.SessionWordsSolved + 1
        SolvedCounterVal.Text = tostring(State.SessionWordsSolved)
        MatchesVal.Text = countMatchWords() .. " words"

        appendLog(string.format("Prompt: '%s' -> Word: '%s' [%s Mode, Match #%d]", prompt, targetWord, State.StrategyMode, countMatchWords()), Theme.Success)

        -- Clear any extra keys lingering on board before typing
        clearExtraKeys(md, #prompt)

        -- 1. Human Thinking / Reaction time
        if not State.InstantSolve and State.ReactionDelayMs > 0 then
            local jitter = math.random(85, 125) / 100
            local thinkTime = (State.ReactionDelayMs / 1000) * jitter
            task.wait(thinkTime)
        end

        -- Re-verify turn is still ours
        if LocalPlayer:GetAttribute("IsTurn") ~= true then
            State.CurrentTurnSolved = false
            return
        end

        -- Helper to type suffix of a word
        local function typeWord(word)
            local suffix = word:sub(#prompt + 1)
            if #suffix > 0 then
                local prevChar = ""
                for i = 1, #suffix do
                    local char = suffix:sub(i, i):upper()
                    if not State.InstantSolve then
                        local baseDelay = State.HumanDelayMs / 1000
                        local jitter = (math.random(85, 125) / 100) * baseDelay
                        if char == prevChar then
                            task.wait(math.max(jitter * 1.4, 0.12))
                        else
                            task.wait(jitter)
                        end
                    else
                        if char == prevChar then task.wait(0.06) elseif i > 1 then task.wait(0.02) end
                    end
                    typeLetter(char)
                    prevChar = char
                end
            end

            -- Pre-submit pause
            if not State.InstantSolve and State.PreSubmitDelayMs > 0 then
                local submitJitter = (math.random(85, 125) / 100) * (State.PreSubmitDelayMs / 1000)
                task.wait(submitJitter)
            else
                task.wait(0.04)
            end

            trySubmit()
            appendLog(string.format("Submitted '%s'!", word), Theme.Accent)
        end

        -- Type and submit primary word
        typeWord(targetWord)

        -- 2. DYNAMIC SERVER VERIFICATION & AUTO-RETRY ENGINE
        -- If the server rejects the word (e.g. word already used or not in server dict),
        -- IsTurn remains true! We detect this within 280ms, backspace, and submit an alternate candidate.
        task.delay(0.28, function()
            if LocalPlayer:GetAttribute("IsTurn") == true then
                appendLog(string.format("Server rejected '%s'! Auto-correcting...", targetWord), Theme.Warning)
                BlacklistedWords[targetWord] = true
                MatchUsedWords[targetWord] = true

                -- Backspace the rejected suffix
                local suffixLen = #targetWord - #prompt
                for _ = 1, suffixLen do
                    backspace()
                    task.wait(0.035)
                end

                -- Find alternative word
                local altWord = findWordForPrompt(prompt)
                if altWord then
                    appendLog(string.format("Alternate word found: '%s'", altWord), Theme.Success)
                    recordWordUsed(altWord)
                    MatchState.NextSuggestedWord = altWord
                    WordVal.Text = altWord
                    typeWord(altWord)
                else
                    appendLog("No alternate candidate found for this turn.", Theme.Danger)
                end
            end
        end)
    end)

    if not ok and err then
        appendLog("Solver Error: " .. tostring(err), Theme.Danger)
        State.CurrentTurnSolved = false
    end
end

local function updateOpponentDisplay(tableId)
    local opps = {}
    for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if p ~= LocalPlayer and p:GetAttribute("InGame") == tostring(tableId) then
            table.insert(opps, string.format("%s (@%s)", p.DisplayName, p.Name))
        end
    end
    if #opps > 0 then
        MatchState.OpponentName = table.concat(opps, ", ")
    else
        MatchState.OpponentName = "Waiting for player..."
    end
    OpponentVal.Text = MatchState.OpponentName
end

local function handleMatchStart(tableId)
    MatchState.CurrentTableId = tableId
    MatchState.InMatch = true
    State.CurrentTurnSolved = false
    resetMatchWords("Match Start")
    State.SessionMatchesPlayed = State.SessionMatchesPlayed + 1
    MatchCounterVal.Text = tostring(State.SessionMatchesPlayed)

    updateOpponentDisplay(tableId)
    appendLog(string.format("🎮 [MATCH START] Table #%s vs %s", tostring(tableId), MatchState.OpponentName), Theme.Success)
    updateStatusPill(string.format("TABLE #%s (ACTIVE)", tostring(tableId)), Theme.Success)
end

local function handleMatchEnd(reason)
    if MatchState.InMatch or MatchState.CurrentTableId ~= nil or countMatchWords() > 0 then
        appendLog(string.format("🏁 [MATCH OVER] %s", reason or "Game Concluded"), Theme.Accent)
        MatchState.InMatch = false
        State.CurrentTurnSolved = false
        resetMatchWords(reason or "Match Ended")
        updateStatusPill("LOBBY / INTERMISSION", Theme.TextMuted)
    end
end

-- 3. Supervisor Loop (Auto-Sit, Turn Recovery, Waiting Queue)
local lastCheck = 0
local lastRewardClaim = 0
trackConn(RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
    local now = os.clock()
    if now - lastCheck < 0.25 then return end
    lastCheck = now

    local inGameId = LocalPlayer:GetAttribute("InGame")

    -- Turn solver supervisor
    if State.AutoSolve and inGameId and LocalPlayer:GetAttribute("IsTurn") == true and not State.CurrentTurnSolved then
        solveCurrentTurn()
    end

    -- Match Results / Popup Detection
    local rmr = PlayerGui:FindFirstChild("RankedMatchResults") or PlayerGui:FindFirstChild("RankedMatchOver") or PlayerGui:FindFirstChild("RequeueScreen")
    local blur = game:GetService("Lighting"):FindFirstChild("RankedMatchResultsBlur")
    if rmr or blur then
        if countMatchWords() > 0 or MatchState.InMatch then
            handleMatchEnd("Match Over Screen Detected")
        end
    end

    -- Waiting room status detection (1/2 players at table or waiting intermission)
    if inGameId and inGameId ~= "" then
        local tableObj = workspace:FindFirstChild("Meta") and workspace.Meta:FindFirstChild("Tables") and workspace.Meta.Tables:FindFirstChild(tostring(inGameId))
        local tModel = tableObj and tableObj:FindFirstChild("Table")
        local bg = tModel and tModel:FindFirstChild("BillboardGui")
        local pc = bg and bg:FindFirstChild("PlayerCount")
        if pc and pc.Visible then
            if countMatchWords() > 0 and MatchState.InMatch then
                handleMatchEnd("Table Intermission")
            end
            if pc.Text:find("1/2") and PillText.Text ~= "WAITING (1/2)" then
                updateStatusPill("WAITING (1/2)", Theme.Warning)
                appendLog("⏳ [TABLE " .. tostring(inGameId) .. "] Waiting for opponent to sit down (1/2)...", Theme.Warning)
            end
        end
    end

    -- Auto Sit Worker (Prioritizes 1/2 players, then 0/2)
    if State.AutoSit and not inGameId then
        local tables = workspace:FindFirstChild("Meta") and workspace.Meta:FindFirstChild("Tables")
        if tables then
            local sat = false
            -- Priority 1: Tables waiting with 1/2 or 2/3
            for _, t in ipairs(tables:GetChildren()) do
                local tModel = t:FindFirstChild("Table")
                local bg = tModel and tModel:FindFirstChild("BillboardGui")
                local pc = bg and bg:FindFirstChild("PlayerCount")
                if pc and pc.Visible and (pc.Text:find("1/2") or pc.Text:find("2/3")) then
                    if attemptSitAtTable(t) then
                        sat = true
                        break
                    end
                end
            end
            -- Priority 2: Any open table
            if not sat then
                for _, t in ipairs(tables:GetChildren()) do
                    local tModel = t:FindFirstChild("Table")
                    local bg = tModel and tModel:FindFirstChild("BillboardGui")
                    local pc = bg and bg:FindFirstChild("PlayerCount")
                    if pc and pc.Visible and not pc.Text:find("2/2") and not pc.Text:find("3/3") then
                        if attemptSitAtTable(t) then
                            break
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end

    -- Periodic Reward Claiming (Every 12s)
    if State.AutoClaimRewards and (now - lastRewardClaim > 12) then
        lastRewardClaim = now
        pcall(fireClaimRewards)
    end

    -- Update Uptime
    local elapsed = os.time() - State.SessionStartTime
    local mins = math.floor(elapsed / 60)
    local secs = elapsed % 60
    UptimeVal.Text = string.format("%02d:%02d", mins, secs)
end))

-- 4. Game Remotes (EndGame, Requeue)
if EventService then
    pcall(function()
        EventService.remoteConnect("endGame", function(data)
            handleMatchEnd("EndGame Event Received")
            if State.AutoRequeue then
                task.wait(0.8)
                appendLog("🔄 [AUTO REQUEUE] Requesting next match...", Theme.Accent)
                pcall(function() EventService.remoteFire("requeue") end)
                pcall(function() EventService.remoteFire("autoRequeue") end)
            end
        end)
    end)
end

-- 5. Anti-AFK Keep Alive
trackConn(LocalPlayer.Idled:Connect(function()
    if State.AntiAFK then
        VirtualUser:CaptureController()
        VirtualUser:ClickButton2(Vector2.new(0, 0))
        appendLog("🛡️ [ANTI-AFK] Virtual input simulated to prevent disconnect.", Theme.Accent)
    end
end))

-- 6. Movement & Physics Hooks (Infinite Jump, Noclip, WalkSpeed)
trackConn(UserInputService.JumpRequest:Connect(function()
    if State.InfJump and LocalPlayer.Character then
        local hum = LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Humanoid")
        if hum then hum:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Jumping) end
    end
end))

trackConn(RunService.Stepped:Connect(function()
    if State.Noclip and LocalPlayer.Character then
        for _, part in ipairs(LocalPlayer.Character:GetDescendants()) do
            if part:IsA("BasePart") and part.CanCollide then
                part.CanCollide = false
            end
        end
    end
    if State.SpeedHack and LocalPlayer.Character then
        local hum = LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Humanoid")
        if hum and hum.WalkSpeed ~= State.SpeedValue then
            hum.WalkSpeed = State.SpeedValue
        end
    end
end))

-- 7. Toggle Keybind (RightControl / RightShift)
trackConn(UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, gpe)
    if not gpe and (input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.RightControl or input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.RightShift) then
        Window.Visible = not Window.Visible
    end
end))

-- 8. Complete Cleanup Handler
_G.ExodevTH_Cleanup = function()
    if ScreenGui then ScreenGui:Destroy() end
    if _G.ExodevTH_Conns then
        for _, c in ipairs(_G.ExodevTH_Conns) do
            pcall(function()
                if typeof(c) == "RBXScriptConnection" then
                    c:Disconnect()
                elseif typeof(c) == "table" and EventService then
                    EventService.disconnect(c)
                end
            end)
        end
        _G.ExodevTH_Conns = {}
    end
    State.AutoSolve = false
    State.InfJump = false
    State.Noclip = false
    State.SpeedHack = false
    if LocalPlayer.Character then
        local hum = LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Humanoid")
        if hum then hum.WalkSpeed = 16 end
        for _, p in ipairs(LocalPlayer.Character:GetDescendants()) do
            if p:IsA("BasePart") then p.CanCollide = true end
        end
    end
end

-- Select Default Tab
if _G.ExodevTH_SelectTab then
    _G.ExodevTH_SelectTab("Auto Solver")
end

appendLog(string.format("Loaded %d verified English words.", TOTAL_WORDS), Theme.Accent)
appendLog("Press [RightControl] to Hide / Show Hub.", Theme.TextMuted)
